proves.claim: A next --wait 2 against a fake clock the test advances returns its idle answer only once the fake clock has passed 2 minutes.

cli.io-commands-next-wait.fake-clock-idl.why: Without it, the wait deadline reads real time and a test can only prove it by waiting real minutes.

proves.claim: A wake from a newly filed item returns the waiting next at once whatever its fake clock says.

cli.io-commands-next-wait.fake-clock-wak.why: Without it, a driven clock could hide a wait that ignores board wakes.
